scope: Pre-physical-outcome qualification of the identical per-parent covariance scorer. Synthetic label grids, not physical endpoints or new trajectories. Fixed once; no seed, density, or signal searches.
geometry: Periodic 20 cubed; native array axis 0,1,2 equals component 0,1,2. Positive displacements 3 through 9, specifically equal-weight 5,6 primary. Inspect full geometric star support under periodic wrap, joint endpoint mask and both conditional endpoint means. Counts <=1 render the axis unsupported; all three axes required and both primary distances required.
scale: Each synthetic field component is a fair +/-1 in the generating law (one copy), so its total reference component variance is exactly 1. Equivalence and minimum interesting effect = 0.01 unit of this total variance. Scale is fixed analytically, never estimated from qualification parents.
plant: 128 fixed independent parent arrays. For each parent draw independent unit Gaussian noise E[c,site] by NumPy default_rng([711526,parent,0]). Score sign(E[c,s] + sum over a and d=5,6 of b[c,a]*E[c,s+d*e_a]) as one three-bit label. b[c,c]=+0.040; b[c,a!=c]=-0.036. Independent white-noise control uses sign(E) on the identical sites. Exact population covariances at both primary distances: (2/pi)*asin(b[c,a]/(1+2*.040^2+4*.036^2)). Thus true L>0 and T<0, neither sign inferred from outcomes. The n-1 sample estimator on a periodic correlated graph can have a small finite-aperture bias; compare, do not identify it identically with the population law.
aperture_and_null: IID Bernoulli .16 eligibility using default_rng([711526,parent,1]); set other labels to -1. Within each parent use one uniform permutation of labels only at eligible sites, default_rng([711526,parent,2]); same shuffle for all fields and distances. No spatial shuffling between parents. Use same eligible indices and random streams for white-noise control. Permutation does not imply each realized shuffled covariance is identically zero.
checks: Compare exact score against independent explicitly centered endpoint-dot-product oracle on asymmetric nonconstant model/copy vectors, both original and a reproduced permutation; tolerate 3e-12 absolute/relative. Include flat/3-D and exact count replay.

Mask-confounding fixture has occupied coordinate planes 0,1,5,6,13 on axis 0, constant first component 2 on planes 0,1 and -1 on 5,6; remaining plane 3. At d=5 the left and right means differ: actual L=0, naive globally centered L nonzero. Constant fields have zero true and shuffled covariance. Empty and one-bond unsupported footprints yield NaN, not absence.

For independent parents use signed equal-axis, equal-distance mean; report t intervals based on parents for raw plant, shuffled plant, their paired difference, raw white noise, shuffled white noise and white-noise paired difference. Report analytic target, error, support and actual parent-level precision; do not treat edges as independent. At minimum, plant point estimates within .01 of known L,T, their signed intervals exclude zero, shuffled plant and white-noise intervals do not promote a meaningful effect outside +/-0.01. Track interval containment in equivalence margin separately; crossing either margin is not evidence for equality.
Lock exact qualification inputs and this declaration before accessing outcomes. Record observed passes and failures without tuning.
